tasks.label: colcon: test (all)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && colcon test --parallel-workers 2 && colcon test-result --verbose'

tasks.label: run: vision pipeline (real camera)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup vision.launch.py'

tasks.label: run: camera only (real MVS)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch hikrobot_camera_ros2 camera.launch.py'

tasks.label: run: preview (real camera)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup preview.launch.py'

tasks.label: run: calibration (real camera)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup calibration.launch.py size:=8x6 square:=0.025'

tasks.label: view: raw camera image
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup image_viewer.launch.py image_topic:=/camera/image_raw'

tasks.label: view: YOLO debug image
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup image_viewer.launch.py image_topic:=/vision/debug_image'

tasks.label: run: vision health check
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run dmu_vision_tools vision_health_check --measure 5'
